verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents a multi-session feature to start multiple agents in parallel on the same project. Its `--auto` flag automatically approves permission requests that are not explicitly denied, which supports unattended runs. It also offers a headless `serve` mode and GitHub Actions execution. However, nothing documents fleet-scale orchestration or runs lasting hours or days, and one user reports agents getting stuck in long or nested sessions. missing for 10: fleet-level orchestration across different tasks/repos, documented long-running (hours/days) autonomous execution, independent corroboration of sustained parallel runs.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: Start multiple agents in parallel on the same project
Start OpenCode with `--auto` to automatically approve permission requests that are not explicitly denied.
The opencode serve command runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint that an opencode client can use.
OpenCode will execute tasks within your GitHub Actions runner.
